zotero.abstractNote: We present LAION-Audio-XL, a web-scale corpus of 1.1 billion audio-text pairs, and use it to study the scaling behavior of contrastive audio-language models. We investigate the impact of model size, dataset size, and training duration on performance, and propose a novel audio encoder architecture, NaFlex, which is designed for efficient scaling. Our results demonstrate that scaling both the model and the dataset leads to significant improvements in audio-text retrieval and audio captioning tasks.
